title: Rat's Register Allocator
summary: A technical blog post discussing the implementation of a register allocator for a compiler or assembler project, shared by a developer using the nickname 'Rat' on their personal website. The post appears to cover compiler optimization techniques for efficiently managing CPU registers during code generation.
problem_solved: Efficiently allocating CPU registers to program variables during compilation, a fundamental NP-hard optimization problem in compiler backends.
why_valuable: Register allocation is critical for generating performant machine code, and implementing a custom allocator demonstrates deep understanding of compiler internals and low-level system behavior.
